title: Visiting Artist Workshop: The Alternative Firing Experience with Vicente Garcia
source_quote: In this hands-on workshop, participants will work with basic and advanced techniques designed to help develop skills in the application and alternative firing processes Vicente Garcia uses.
evidence_sentence: The workshop teaches alternative firing processes and techniques used by visiting artist Vicente Garcia.
evidence_quote: participants will work with basic and advanced techniques designed to help develop skills in the application and alternative firing processes Vicente Garcia uses
summary: A two-day hands-on workshop (March 8–9, 2027) with visiting artist Vicente Garcia covering alternative firing processes. All materials are provided. Registration is open.
